spans.s: अह्नाय ind. Instantly, speedily, at once, अह्नाय सा नियमजं क्लममुत्ससर्ज K.S.v.86, R.v.71.
आह्न n. A series of days.
आह्निक (I) a. (f. की) Daily, performed every day.
आह्निक (II) n. 1. A religious ceremony to be performed every day at a fixed hour; 2. daily work.
